name: obsidian-tracekeeper
description: Connect AI agents to your vault through a local MCP runtime, with scoped recall and governed memory updates.

scripts.benchmark:index: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/mcp-runtime && node --expose-gc ./benchmarks/knowledge-index/run.mjs
scripts.benchmark:index:replay: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/mcp-runtime && node --expose-gc ./benchmarks/knowledge-index/replay.mjs
scripts.benchmark:index:test: npm run build --workspace packages/core && npm run build --workspace packages/mcp-runtime && node --test ./benchmarks/knowledge-index/*.test.mjs
scripts.version: node ./version-bump.mjs && node ./scripts/build_tracekeeper_skill.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json package.json package-lock.json apps/obsidian-plugin/manifest.json apps/obsidian-plugin/package.json apps/obsidian-plugin/package-lock.json apps/obsidian-plugin/src/composition/local-tool-executor.ts apps/mcp-server/package.json apps/mcp-server/package-lock.json packages/contracts/package.json packages/core/package.json packages/core/package-lock.json packages/mcp-runtime/package.json packages/mcp-runtime/src/handler.ts skills/tracekeeper/release.json skills/tracekeeper/manifest.json skills/tracekeeper/dist/tracekeeper.flattened.md
